reasoning.description: Use this exclusively for scratchpad reasoning; every finding you want reported must go in the findings array, never here.

end_line.description: Optional end line for a multi-line span.

label.description: The conventional-comments label for this finding.

decoration.description: The bare decoration keyword. Omit (or set null) for a praise finding; every other label requires one.

confidence.description: 0-100. Only emit findings you are >= 80% confident are real.

subject.description: A short description of the finding.

body.description: Detailed explanation in conventional-comments format with a concrete fix.

findings.description: The reviewer's findings, one entry per issue/praise/etc.

considered_approach.description: An approach you considered while reviewing a hunk of the reviewed code.

why_rejected.description: Why the code as written is preferable to the considered approach.

rejected_alternatives.description: Code-scoped claims about approaches you considered and rejected while reviewing. A genuine none is the empty array; do not omit this key.

location.description: The file:line of the off-pattern in the reviewed code.

pattern.description: The off-pattern observed — not itself a findings entry.

recommendation.description: What the next person touching this code should do.

anti_patterns_found.description: Code-scoped off-patterns you noticed but didn't surface as a findings entry. A genuine none is the empty array; do not omit this key.
